mapper.sql: public_profile_id, member_id, public_name, bio, profile_file_id, social_url, visibility_status_code, created_dttm, updated_dttm
public_profile_consent_id, public_profile_id, policy_document_version_id, consent_scope_code, is_agreed, agreed_dttm, revoked_dttm, recorded_by_member_id
mapper.select: SELECT FROM public_profile WHERE public_profile_id = #{publicProfileId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM public_profile WHERE public_profile_id = #{publicProfileId} AND visibility_status_code = 'PUBLISHED'
SELECT FROM public_profile_consent WHERE public_profile_consent_id = #{publicProfileConsentId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT consent.consent_scope_code FROM public_profile_consent consent JOIN policy_document_version version ON version.policy_document_version_id = consent.policy_document_version_id JOIN policy_document document ON document.policy_document_id = version.policy_document_id WHERE consent.public_profile_id = #{publicProfileId} AND consent.is_agreed = 1 AND consent.revoked_dttm IS NULL AND document.is_active = 1 AND version.published_dttm <= #{currentDttm} AND version.effective_from_dttm <= #{currentDttm} AND consent.public_profile_consent_id = ( SELECT recent_consent.public_profile_consent_id FROM public_profile_consent recent_consent JOIN policy_document_version recent_version ON recent_version.policy_document_version_id = recent_consent.policy_document_version_id WHERE recent_consent.public_profile_id = consent.public_profile_id AND recent_consent.consent_scope_code = consent.consent_scope_code AND recent_version.published_dttm <= #{currentDttm} AND recent_version.effective_from_dttm <= #{currentDttm} ORDER BY recent_version.effective_from_dttm DESC, recent_version.policy_document_version_id DESC, recent_consent.public_profile_consent_id DESC LIMIT 1 )
SELECT FROM public_profile_consent WHERE public_profile_id = #{publicProfileId} ORDER BY agreed_dttm DESC, public_profile_consent_id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE public_profile SET public_name = #{publicName}, bio = #{bio}, profile_file_id = #{profileFileId}, social_url = #{socialUrl}, visibility_status_code = #{visibilityStatus} WHERE public_profile_id = #{publicProfileId}
